The King of Drok Shah, Amir Khan, is executed by Queen Kagerra of Agamarth for refusing to raise taxes on his subjects in her vassal state. His son Igan, takes the title of Khan, and openly calls for Kagerra's head, beginning a war between the Elven nations. The war lasts 2 years and ends in Drok Shah becoming independent. It is called the War of Miracles because it is said to be a miracle that Drok Shah won, considering they were outnumbered in the many hundreds of thousands of soldiers.
